title: Junior AI Developer at AutoMate PH

content.body:
As of August 17, 2026. I am officially a Junior Developer at AutoMate PH. This is my first ever job towards my future goal, which is to be an AI Engineer. 

I am actually happy since I got with my trusted friend, Skhart Mercado. Total buddies since college, and now, workmates!

Hoping for a successful career journey!

Today I officially launched my portfolio website. It represents months of work across machine learning, IoT, and full-stack projects. Building this site was an exercise in restraint — choosing what to show, how to frame it, and what story it tells about where I'm headed.

The long-term goal is a research-track path in machine learning. Every project here — from smoke emission detection with CNNs to locally run RAG pipelines — is a stepping stone toward contributing genuinely new ideas to the field.

Started working on AIxia — a document assistant that uses retrieval-augmented generation to answer questions grounded in your own files. The challenge isn't just plumbing RAG together; it's making the responses feel trustworthy when the context window is limited and the embeddings need to actually capture meaning.
Currently experimenting with different chunking strategies and local LLM backends. The goal is zero cloud dependency — everything runs on your machine.

Wrapped up SMOKi — an IoT-driven vehicle smoke emission classification system. The hardware captures exhaust samples, a CNN classifies emission levels, and a data analytics dashboard surfaces patterns across test runs.

The hardest part was getting reliable sensor readings in non-laboratory conditions. Noise from temperature, humidity, and sensor drift required careful preprocessing before anything touched the model.
